description: Inline implementation of StaticRangeMap class template functions for range retrieval operations, used in breakpad crash reporting library.

classes.name: StaticRangeMap
classes.description: Template class implementing range mapping and retrieval functions based on address ranges.

methods.name: RetrieveRange
methods.description: Retrieves the range entry that contains the specified address.

methods.name: RetrieveNearestRange
methods.description: Retrieves the range entry nearest to the specified address, either containing it or immediately preceding it.

methods.name: RetrieveRangeAtIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the range entry at a specific index in the internal map.
